title: Single-Use only — a multi-use ticket's Collect Ticket Code is rejected
preface: This test is to confirm the TVM rejects a Collect Ticket Code for a multiple-use ticket, which it does not validate. Collection on the TVM is Collect-Ticket-Code entry only — there is no barcode scanner (FBD-100317; confirmed by George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21).
preconds:
**GIVEN** a customer is at the TVM Collect Tickets screen
**AND** a Collect Ticket Code for a multiple-use (mLink/Flowbird) ticket that the TVM does not support per FBD-100167

steps.content: **WHEN** the customer enters the multiple-use ticket's Collect Ticket Code
steps.expected:
**THEN** the message "This Barcode Type is not accepted on this device" is displayed
**AND** no redemption is performed

citations: FBD-100317 (TVM = Collect Ticket Code entry only, no scanner)
FBD-100167 (multiple-use barcode types not accepted on this device)
change_note: Removed the 2026-07-17 UNCONFIRMED scanner marker — now confirmed by George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21: the TVM has no barcode scanner, Collect-Ticket-Code entry only. Reworded the trigger from 'the multiple-use barcode is presented' to 'the customer enters the ... Collect Ticket Code', matching the entry mechanism already used in C4103620/C4103629. The rejection message itself was already correct and is unchanged.

title: Ticket Collection — collect a pre-paid ticket using a booking reference (Collect Ticket Code)
preface: This test is to confirm a customer can collect a pre-paid ticket by entering a valid booking reference via Collect Ticket Code entry. The TVM has no barcode scanner and does not accept a BRID scan — booking-reference/Collect Ticket Code entry only (FBD-100317; confirmed by George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21).
preconds:
**GIVEN** a TVM on the ticket collection screen
**AND** an example valid booking reference (Collect Ticket Code) for a pre-paid ticket

steps.content: **WHEN** the customer enters the valid booking reference (Collect Ticket Code)

citations: FBD-100317 (TVM = Collect Ticket Code entry only, no scanner, no BRID)
change_note: Renamed away from 'BRID' — BRID (12-digit) is the POS/HHD fallback mechanism per FBD-100317, not a TVM capability, and using it here mis-attributed a POS/HHD mechanism to the TVM (also contradicted C4103629's 'no ... BRID scan input is offered'). Reworded title/preface/step to booking reference / Collect Ticket Code entry, matching C4103620's wording pattern. This case duplicates the entry-validation cases already in Barcode Redemption (C4103620/25/26); flagged as a possible future fold, not actioned here (out of scope for this fix).
gaps: C4103729–C4103732 (Ticket Collection section) duplicate the entry-validation cases already in Barcode Redemption (C4103620/25/26) — candidate for consolidation in a future pass, not part of this fix.

title: Ticket Collection — a pre-paid ticket is collected and printed
preface: This test is to confirm a customer can collect a pre-paid ticket and receive a printed ticket, by entering the booking reference (Collect Ticket Code) — the TVM has no barcode scanner (FBD-100317; confirmed by George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21).
preconds:
**GIVEN** a TVM (Kiosk or Astreo) is at the Sales home screen with ticket paper loaded
**AND** an example pre-paid order identified by a valid booking reference (Collect Ticket Code)

steps.content:
**WHEN** the customer selects Collect
**AND** enters the booking reference (Collect Ticket Code)
steps.expected:
**THEN** the pre-paid ticket is printed
**AND** presented at the ticket chute
**AND** a confirmation of collection is displayed

citations: FBD-100317 (TVM = Collect Ticket Code entry only, no scanner)
change_note: Dropped 'barcode' and 'presents' — the precondition 'identified by a valid collection barcode or booking code' and the step 'presents the collection reference' both implied a scan, which the TVM cannot do. Reworded to booking reference / Collect Ticket Code entry, consistent with C4103620/C4103629/C4103628/C4103729.

title: Banknotes — a Scottish banknote is accepted as valid sterling
preface: This test is to confirm the TVM accepts a Scottish-issued banknote as valid sterling currency, the same as a Bank of England note. **CORRECTED 2026-07-21** — this case previously asserted the note was rejected as 'foreign/non-sterling', which was factually wrong: Scottish banknotes are sterling, issued under UK law, not foreign currency. George confirms it should be accepted like any other GBP note (gap-register Q15).
preconds:
**GIVEN** a TVM is at the payment screen for a cash transaction
**AND** a valid Scottish-issued banknote (e.g. Bank of Scotland / RBS / Clydesdale Bank) is to be used

steps.content: **WHEN** the customer inserts the Scottish banknote
steps.expected:
**THEN** the note is accepted
**AND** the amount paid increases by the note's value

citations: George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21 — gap-register Q15 (Scottish notes are sterling; expected outcome was wrong)
change_note: Flipped the expected outcome from 'rejected as foreign/non-sterling' to 'accepted', per George's confirmation that Scottish banknotes are sterling. Retitled from 'foreign notes are rejected' to 'a Scottish banknote is accepted as valid sterling' so the title/preface stay coherent with the corrected (accept) outcome — a title claiming rejection with an accept expected-result would itself be an audit-blocking incoherence. This also resolves the contradiction the audit flagged against C4103639 ('valid UK banknotes from every issuing bank').
gaps: This case was the only 'foreign notes rejected' case in the Payments — Cash section and its premise (Scottish = foreign) was wrong, so repurposing it to 'Scottish accepted' leaves no case exercising genuine non-sterling currency (e.g. Euro) rejection for banknotes. C4103638 covers foreign COINS being rejected, but no sibling case covers foreign banknotes. Confirm whether a dedicated foreign-banknote-rejection case is needed — not added here as it would be new coverage, out of scope for this fix.

title: Buy a Smartcard — issuing a new journey-based card writes the product and prints a receipt
citations: FBD-100261 ("POS is the only device that issues these smartcard products")
George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21 — gap-register Q6: TVM has no smartcard reader/writer, issue/read is POS/Card-Bureau only
change_note: Condemned. Premise (TVM issues a new Multi-Journey smartcard) is wrong — confirmed by George: the TVM has no smartcard reader/writer at all; issue is POS-only (FBD-100261). Nothing salvageable at the TVM — there is no TVM-side smartcard action to reword this into.

title: Smartcard Top-up — adding journeys to a Multi-Journey card updates the balance and prints a receipt
citations: George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21 — gap-register Q6: TVM has no smartcard reader/writer at all (not issue-only restricted — read/top-up also impossible)
change_note: Condemned. Top-up requires presenting the card to a reader and writing the new balance; George confirmed the TVM has no smartcard reader/writer whatsoever, so there is no TVM-side top-up action to salvage. Smartcard top-up is a POS/Card-Bureau capability.

title: Smartcard Top-up — a Travelcard or Period Pass top-up adds a period and prints a receipt
change_note: Condemned — same reason as C4103600: no TVM smartcard reader/writer, so period-pass top-up at the TVM is not a real capability.

title: Smartcard Top-up — top-up amount labels come from the recharge product Display Descriptions
change_note: Condemned — depends on presenting a smartcard to the TVM to reach the top-up screen, which is not possible; the SmartRecharge labelling behaviour itself may be valid on POS but this case is scoped to the TVM.

title: Smartcard Details — presenting a card displays its details screen
change_note: Condemned — requires the TVM to read a presented smartcard, which it cannot do (no reader).

title: Mini Statement — a mini-statement prints the card balance after a top-up
change_note: Condemned — depends on a prior TVM smartcard top-up (itself impossible) and reading the card to print its balance. Also flagged by the audit as a duplicate of C4103733.

title: Concession — a yLink smartcard prices a ticket at the yLink concessionary fare
change_note: Condemned — concession pricing here depends on presenting a physical yLink smartcard to the TVM's reader, which does not exist. Concession-by-smartcard at the TVM is not a real capability; the fare taxonomy itself (yLink) is fine, only the device attribution is wrong.

title: Concession — a 24+ smartcard prices a ticket at the 24+ discounted fare
